member.label: Members
member.headline: Everyday workflow for verified cooperative shareholders
member.s1Summary: Submit your application on Join Amanah with NID, nominee details, portrait photo, and an existing member reference.
member.s2Summary: Deposit ৳5,000 per share by the 10th via Bank or MFS, then upload the receipt or transaction ID in Contributions.
member.s3Summary: Apply for a 0% interest loan (up to ৳50,000 or 75% of your savings) and submit monthly installments over up to 10 months.

manager.label: Shura Managers

manager.s3Summary: Close voting once quorum is met, reveal anonymized tallies, and record disbursement proof for approved loans.
manager.s4Summary: Publish Halal investment proposals for 2/3 voting, create community polls, and sync Shura meeting notices.

admin.s3Summary: Upload the signed cooperative constitution PDF in Site Settings so all visitors and members can view or download it.
admin.s4Summary: Verify the SHA-256 audit log chain, mirror treasury tabs to Google Sheets, and export periodic financial reports.
